text:
ana-marketing: Short idea: run an EU-focused pricing microtest next week. Test VAT visibility (inline vs footnote) + CTA wording and tie high-value calculator submissions to a webinar opt-in. Goal: clearer EU pricing, fewer FAQ opens, better webinar-qualified leads.

tom-growth: Agree. Axes: VAT inline vs VAT modal; CTA A: 'Get started 14-day trial' vs CTA B: 'Estimate your monthly cost'. Also swap one tier name: 'Company' vs 'Scale'.

mira-ux: I'll produce 3 quick mocks: (1) VAT inline + inline calc, (2) price without VAT then VAT modal toggle, (3) localized EUR with VAT included. Figma placeholder: https://figma.com/eu-pricing.

kai-analytics: Events: pricing_view, calc_opened, calc_submitted (props: country, currency, est_band), webinar_signup. I'll build a Looker funnel and daily delta report. Gate by region (EU vs non-EU).

leah-cs: Routing rule: if est_band is 'enterprise' or user opts into webinar and indicates "evaluating for company", route to AE queue with tag `lead:pricing_calc_webinar`. Add est_band, currency, vat_flag to webhook.

arnaud-legal: I'll review wording for "VAT included" vs "VAT calculated at checkout". Need final copy 48h before launch. Avoid definitive guarantees.

devops-bot: rollout: flag=pricing_eu_vat_test. Canary 5% for 72h, check pricing_endpoint latency and calc_submitted error rate. Notify #release-war-room on anomalies.

ana-marketing: Acceptance criteria: primary = start_trial_ctr lift; secondary = webinar_reg_rate uplift, faq_open_rate down 10%. Run until 8k pricing impressions or 10 days. Mira deliver mocks Tue, Kai finalize events Mon, Legal sign-off Fri.

ana-marketing: I'll post brief to #marketing-review and tag Eng for flagging estimate. :spiral_calendar:
